description: Source code for the LeavePolicyAssignment class and related functions in the HR module of an ERP system, managing leave policy assignments, allocations, and related validations.

classes.name: LeavePolicyAssignment
classes.description: Class representing a leave policy assignment, handling validation, leave allocation, and overlap checks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the leave policy assignment, checking for overlaps.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform upon submission, such as granting leave allocations.

methods.name: set_dates
methods.description: Sets effective from and to dates based on assignment basis.

methods.name: validate_policy_assignment_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping leave policy assignments for the same employee.

methods.name: grant_leave_alloc_for_employee
methods.description: Allocates leave for the employee based on the policy, if not already allocated.

methods.name: create_leave_allocation
methods.description: Creates a leave allocation record for the employee.

methods.name: get_new_leaves
methods.description: Calculates new leave days to allocate, considering leave type and employee join date.

methods.name: get_leaves_for_passed_months
methods.description: Calculates leave for months passed since employee joined.
